source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: The 47 keys of @emotion/unitless 0.10.0 plus gridArea and lineClamp, which React 19 also treats as unitless (gridArea: 2 became grid-area:2px, lineClamp: 3 line-clamp:3px).

verification.upstreamSuite: The complete VPM Emotion stack is checked against the pinned upstream suite. React 16 development: 413 passing, two documented Babel-plugin differences, eight skipped (423 total). React 18 development: 416 passing, the same two differences, five skipped. Production: five passing and 418 skipped. See scripts/emotion-conformance/README.md for the configuration, adaptations and snapshot counts.
